summary: Iteration 13 Production Quality Audit — PASSING GATE. Backend regression: 189/189 (100%). Frontend audit at 390×844 + 320×680: 46/46 executed checks pass. Key verifications: (1) Welcome page — no 'Français coming soon' text, English chip is static, all 3 CTAs (customer/braider/google) render. (2) Login — Forgot password link REMOVED, sara logs in and lands on /home. (3) Customer profile shows Sara Bello + email + CUSTOMER + FREE badges + 5 menu rows (Saved Styles, Inspiration Photos, Favorite Braiders, Subscription, Notifications) + Sign out. (4) Hairstyle detail page has ONLY back-arrow + bookmark (share icon confirmed removed, DOM query returned 0 share elements). (5) Pro dashboard shows 'Complete your Studio setup 80%' banner and 4-tab bar (Dashboard/Bookings/Growth/My Studio). (6) /pro/bookings has Availability + Services tiles and NO Requests tile. (7) Growth tab has no back arrow (correctly a tab, not a stack screen) and renders BSS score + Braider DNA + Analytics. (8) CRITICAL RESPONSIVE FIX VERIFIED — /pro/availability at 320×680 viewport: all 12 time inputs (6 days × start+end) render with right-edge = 304px, no clipping (fix confirmed for Mon–Sat rows, Sun off). (9) BSS card + Braider DNA card on /pro/studio are Pressable and navigate to /pro/growth. (10) /pro/onboarding self-heals to /pro/dashboard for completed pro. (11) Availability Save button clicks without error. (12) Responsive at 320px: /profile, /pro/dashboard, /ai/style-match, /pro/studio all render without horizontal overflow.

action_items: OPTIONAL (tech debt, not release-blocking): migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web console warnings.
OPTIONAL (cosmetic): the 'git-compare' Feather icon reference is invalid — replace with a valid Feather name (e.g., 'columns', 'copy', or use MaterialCommunityIcons 'compare').

RootErrorBoundary correctly implements getDerivedStateFromError + componentDidCatch (logging via console.warn) + Retry state reset — production-ready.
